title: OpenSpore global semantic reconstruction package and testability map
purpose: First-pass, research-only decomposition of the global SporeApp.exe 3.1.0.22 campaign into semantic reconstruction packages and validation classes. This artifact defines ownership, evidence roots, boundaries, and prerequisite tests; it does not implement or promote any reconstruction.

precedence: Pinned binary bytes and hash-pinned runtime traces or manifests
Pinned Ghidra exports, SDK symbols, structures, and raw xrefs
Triage projections, dependency maps, and readiness audits
Current OpenSpore source, contracts, tests, and fixtures
evidence_policy.semantic_rule: Decompilation, SDK names, vtable candidates, current source, and self-generated fixtures are evidence. They do not establish original behavior without the required runtime or independent differential evidence.

confidence_scale.UNKNOWN: No reliable semantic evidence; absence is recorded rather than filled in.
confidence_scale.APPROXIMATION: A value or behavior chosen for a contract without an original observation.
confidence_scale.INFERRED: A reasoned conclusion from static or indirect evidence.
confidence_scale.SUPPORTED: Multiple consistent sources or a bounded deterministic differential.
confidence_scale.OBSERVED: Directly present in a pinned artifact, current source, test, or generated output; current-code observations do not imply original fidelity.
confidence_scale.CONFIRMED: Directly confirmed in the evidence source, still bounded to the observed artifact or scope.
confidence_scale.VERIFIED: Byte- or runtime-validated under the documented provenance and validation gate.

evidence_policy.unknown_rule: The dominant connected component, shared unnamed roots, unknown-vtable implementations, and unknown-fun mass remain unresolved. No speculative manager identity, event meaning, field meaning, or state transition is assigned merely from a FUN_* name, vtable proximity, or graph connectivity.

validation_classes.deterministic_unit: Fixed native or Python test with no game, display, network, or proprietary-asset dependency.
validation_classes.fixture_comparison: Comparison against a committed synthetic or semantic fixture.
validation_classes.asset_driven: Real GOG package or generated binary-format fixture with identity, structural, or decoded-output checks.
validation_classes.integration: Process, subprocess, JSON-RPC, HTTP, display, GPU, file, or environment boundary.
validation_classes.decomp_differential: Clean-room implementation compared with a decompiler-derived reference; evidence-not-truth and not a live original oracle.
validation_classes.original_binary_oracle: Original SporeApp.exe behavior under Wine or another faithful original-binary execution.
validation_classes.replacement_hook: Controlled native or original-process hook/ABI/control-transfer test.
validation_classes.provenance_negative: Trace provenance and negative-result checks; a zero-event run is evidence only of the recorded negative.
validation_classes.not_yet_testable: Required fixture, implementation seam, environment, or behavioral contract is absent or unreachable.

campaign_partition.partition_note: Packages are semantic ownership boundaries, not per-function claims. The unresolved package covers the long tail without splitting it into invented subsystems.

packages.name: Resource manager, DBPF/QFS I/O, and property substrate
packages.scope: Original resource/IO boundary plus the clean-room DBPF reader. Full multi-package load order and property serialization remain unresolved.

dependencies.boundary_rule: Keep package details behind B1; do not claim original multi-package registry/cache/load-order behavior.

replacement_interface.name: B1 IResourceProvider
replacement_interface.contract: fetch(type, group, instance) returns record bytes plus explicit error. This does not replace original cResourceManager orchestration; property serialization is outside this seam.

packages.name: GMDL/RW4/raster geometry and texture decode
packages.scope: Host-side geometry, model, texture, and container decoding. Renderer fidelity, animation, and unsupported versions remain separate or unresolved.

dependencies.boundary_rule: Do not treat host conversion or accepted opaque trailers as complete RenderWare behavior.

replacement_interface.name: B2 IMeshSource and texture input
replacement_interface.contract: Expose provider-independent Mesh and host texture inputs. No promise of original materials, animation, lighting, or pixels.

packages.name: Cell content and resource record semantics
packages.scope: Typed decoding of CellSerializer-derived and cell-stage resource records, separate from runtime state consumption.

dependencies.boundary_rule: Decode and validate records here; do not infer runtime selection, placement, damage, or AI behavior from names.

replacement_interface.name: Typed Cell resource value boundary
replacement_interface.contract: Expose typed records with type IDs, byte accounting, and reference validation. Runtime selection and original effects remain outside the guarantee.

packages.name: Cell game state, pool, query, advect, and combat rules
packages.scope: Static and pure reconstructions of selected Cell runtime state/rule functions. The original live state machine and timing are not claimed.

dependencies.boundary_rule: Keep pure state/rule functions separate from approximate CellSim and original live ownership.

replacement_interface.name: Typed Cell state host
replacement_interface.contract: Expose deterministic state transitions and pure predicates. No original singleton, event queue, or live object owner is implied.

packages.name: Cell movement and mouse-steering replacement
packages.scope: The narrow movement seam centered on MovePlayerToMousePosition, input/camera dependencies, and the clean-room replacement interface.

dependencies.boundary_rule: Ray-plane structure is supported; lock, pool lookup, runtime plane point, camera/UI gates, omitted callees, and field meanings remain unresolved.

replacement_interface.name: MovePlayerToMousePosition inline seam
replacement_interface.contract: void(float), inherited cdecl frame, balanced stack, documented sCellGame/player fields, target/orientation/moving effects. Mechanism is 5-byte E9 rel32; no Spore patch is installed by this artifact.

packages.name: Cell mode lifecycle and input routing
packages.scope: The original cCellModeStrategy vtable-shaped lifecycle and clean-room IGameMode host boundary. It does not own GFX/UI presentation or the movement body.

dependencies.boundary_rule: IGameMode is a host-side reuse seam, not proof of original app-system behavior.

replacement_interface.name: IGameMode lifecycle manager
replacement_interface.contract: Initialize -> OnEnter -> Update* -> OnExit -> Dispose with table-driven input. This is host-side reuse; original transition claims require a trace.

prerequisites: Separate host tests from original claims

packages.name: Cell GFX, HUD, scene assembly, and renderer boundary
packages.scope: The current vertical-slice presentation path and original cCellGFX/cCellUI/resource-preload anchors. Pixel fidelity and original placement remain unresolved.

dependencies.boundary_rule: Do not promote Vulkan pixels, fixed lighting, or scene positions to original semantics.

replacement_interface.name: B1/B2/B3 composition seam
replacement_interface.contract: Compose provider bytes, provider-independent meshes, and renderer submission. Original placement, material/light behavior, and HUD rendering remain outside the guarantee.

packages.name: Editor and UTFWin message/input dispatch
packages.scope: Editor lifecycle and message-pump boundary needed before claiming menu-to-stage or UI-driven resource behavior.

dependencies.boundary_rule: Do not infer a stage or resource transition from screenshots or a generic frame callback.

replacement_interface.name: Message/input dispatch boundary
replacement_interface.contract: A future interface needs timestamped message/input events and a stage-transition callback. Existing host mode/input interfaces do not define original UTFWin behavior.
